verdict_b_quality.basis: The implementation targets the causal intrinsic-width overflow at the source and reuses the existing shared TabsList primitive.
findings: Inspected installed @ai-matrx/design-system 0.52.0 source map: TabsList renders inline-flex h-9 items-center justify-center-safe; cn() uses tailwind-merge, so caller h-auto replaces h-9 and justify-start replaces justify-center-safe. The class overrides are effective.

Tabs is Radix Root; this caller supplies flex flex-1 flex-col min-h-0. In a column flex container, self-stretch constrains the TabsList cross-axis width; mx-3 leaves 336px at 360px. flex-wrap permits the whitespace-nowrap triggers to flow to another line, while auto height allows that row to be shown.
No hidden-tab, clipping, or bespoke tabs implementation was introduced. Feature test documents all six tabs, viewport overflow, horizontal movement, and title/capture-control visibility.
quality_gaps: Source/class reasoning is not layout proof. Only the requested post-change native run can establish that ancestor sizing/scroll behavior is fixed and normal-width presentation remains acceptable.
